notes.title: Covid-19 Update
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36292571/fcd48b0d7c4b8a5894dc1f9690a8438e1c28574c.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36292571/f9a133fd49f5176afae602a2dc8cf0c83c34fa79.jpg[/img][/url]

OK Boomer has been renamed to Boomer Remover. Covid-19 now plays a major role in this update. I'll be working on a few other things I wasn't able to accomplish today throughout the week. Enjoy the game, eliminate Boomers from the campsite and other locations, which will be coming very soon.

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Happy *Update* Holidays!
notes.content:
[h1]Happy Merry Christmas and the New Year![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36292571/36f1800587529a85e0ea69555b168ac2f5fd388d.jpg[/img]

This update includes two new weapons. Specifically new rifle called "Pen 15" and a "Molotov Cocktail". As well as season "Santa" hat and "Snow" effect across the map. Some weapons have been adjusted. Ammo values were changed too.

Happy holidays!
